description: Render a public web page in headless Chromium (Cloudflare Browser Rendering) and return a screenshot (PNG/JPEG/WebP, base64) for vision models: viewport up to 1920x1920 (default 1920x1080) or full page up to 8000 px. robots.txt respected; every page request is SSRF-guarded; nothing stored. Paid ($0.001, x402).

delay_ms.description: Extra wait after loading, in milliseconds

full_page.description: Capture the whole scrollable page instead of the visible viewport

wait_until.description: When to capture: after the load event or once the network is idle

name: screenshot
title: screenshot
